headline: PPAP Automotive issues press release on Q2 and H1 FY27 results
hook: September quarter numbers out at PPAP Automotive
summary: PPAP Automotive Limited has submitted a press release to the stock exchange regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The disclosure provides details on the company's financial performance during the period. Retail investors holding the stock can review these official filings to assess the company's earnings trajectory and operational performance.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data guides near-term stock price movement.

headline: PPAP Automotive declares interim dividend of Rs 1.50 per share
hook: Third payout this year for PPAP holders
summary: PPAP Automotive Limited announced an interim dividend of Rs 1.5 per equity share following its board meeting on November 06, 2026. This payout provides direct cash returns to the company's equity shareholders. Retail investors holding the stock as of the record date will receive this dividend directly into their accounts.
why_it_matters: Cash payout credited directly to eligible shareholders' accounts.

headline: PPAP Automotive fixes record date for dividend
hook: November payout set for PPAP holders
summary: PPAP Automotive Limited has informed the stock exchanges that November 13, 2026, will serve as the record date for its upcoming dividend. Shareholders listed on the company's registry as of this date will be eligible for the payout. The announcement follows routine corporate action procedures for the automotive components maker. Retail investors holding the stock ahead of the record date qualify to receive the declared dividend.
why_it_matters: Dividend payout credited to eligible PPAP shareholders soon
